name: DDA Tree Traversal with Mini-Stack
definition: A tree traversal algorithm for GPU shaders using a small stack implemented via dynamically indexed local arrays (Shader Model 4.0). It extends the DDA algorithm for regular grids to N-ary trees.
summary: DDA Tree Traversal with Mini-Stack efficiently traverses sparse octrees on GPUs by combining branch-free DDA steps with a fixed-size stack for backtracking, avoiding recursion overhead.
